summary.name: JustMD
summary.one_liner: JustMD is a free, open-source native Markdown editor for Mac that shows formatted text and reveals raw Markdown syntax only on the line you are editing.
use_cases: writing notes in Markdown on a Mac
reading README files with rendered formatting
summary.what_it_does: JustMD renders headings, bold text and similar Markdown as formatted text while you write. Markdown syntax appears only on the line the cursor is on, and is hidden when you move away. A Read mode (Shift-Cmd-E) shows table grids, local images and clickable links, and the rendered page can be printed or saved as PDF. Clicking a checkbox toggles a task item. Files are plain .md files on the Mac that can be opened from Finder or dropped onto the app and used in other editors.
notable: Syntax shown only on the line being edited
Read mode with table grids, local images and PDF export
Plain .md files that stay usable in other editors
caveats: Mac only; requires macOS 14 or later
Some sources list it as available on the Mac App Store
